title: Slippery handles, not great on potatoes
text:
Slippery handles, not great on potatoes. We'll, these work, but I've definitely had far better peelers. The handles are to slick and need to be textured. If your hands are wet, these can and will slide out of your grip.

They are sharp enough to peel most things. Unfortunately, the blades shift and rotate which is a problem with uneven shapes like potatoes. I end up with pits in the potato every time I use these. They are fine on carrots if you can keep a grip. I think I'll just stick with my regular peeler or even a paring knife.
